read.thesis: Organic aggregates shipments fell 1.1% and COGS/ton rose 5.6% on diesel, but LNA added $115M cash gross profit in 40 days and 2027 mid-to-high single digit pricing is guided; supply discipline via network idling is the lever.

capex.quote: our CapEx guide when we do come out with it will include CapEx all in inclusive of acquisitions. But we still expect that to be within that guide that we provided at the Capital Markets Day, which would suggest about 25% of EBITDA.

triggers.label: 2027 mix-adjusted pricing mid-to-high single digit
triggers.quote: we see a nice path to mid to high single digit mix adjusted aggregates growth in 2027
triggers.highlight: mid to high single digit mix adjusted aggregates growth in 2027

triggers.label: Network optimisation: plants idled in ~half of divisions
triggers.quote: we have executed similar actions in roughly half of our divisions. And we continue to look for opportunities to do that across the remainder of the footprint.
triggers.highlight: executed similar actions in roughly half of our divisions

triggers.label: Organic volumes down; Q4 volume down high single digit
triggers.quote: implied in the guide is down high single digit volume. Up on a reported organic basis about 2% pricing.

triggers.label: Organic pricing 2.7% in Q3, Q4 ~2%
triggers.quote: Excluding acquisition and geographic mix, our organic pricing increased 2.7%.

guidance.quote: Full-Year 2026 Revenue Guidance -- $7.75 billion to $7.85 billion, representing an update to reflect stronger acquisition performance.
we are updating our full year revenue and adjusted EBITDA guidance midpoints to $7.8 billion and $2.48 billion respectively.
we are anticipating about $820 million worth of EBITDA for 2027.
We thus expect full year reported ASP growth in the mid single digit range.
